svg.text: MNQ M30, 20 May 2025 01:00 to 21 May 2025 23:30: Q23 short at swing-low support
Q23, short mirror of Q18. Swing low = lowest of 5 bars each side, one-week window;
band = level +/- 0.5 x ATR(14). Markers sit under green signal candles: sell stop at the
candle low, stop at its high, exit after a close below entry - 1R or at the session flatten.
Trades are the verified stage-0 run of the short mirror baseline.
